scope: Persistent requested Wi-Fi policy and bounded lease library, plus an actual read-only NetworkManager CLI probe. The service does not yet load this policy or admit holds; no radio-writing or shutdown path is enabled.

validation.artifact_source: Debug artifacts built from the final working tree subsequently committed as implementation_commit; not a clean packaged runtime image.

properties_exercised: Mode Off remains unmanaged despite holds or a saved Stay connected override; persistent controls use generation checks and remain separate from deployment lifetimes.

Lost-response retries do not allocate another lease. Repeated release of a missing token does not restart quiet grace. Temporary ownership includes UID/PID/process start time; deployment ownership requires the same UID and capability across command gaps.

Setup can renew, time-check and download leases retain absolute limits, and expiry cannot be revived by repeating reserve. Service restart keeps deployment deadlines; reboot grace is persisted and cannot be replenished by repeated restarts/reboots.
Unknown, active or stale SSH/checkpoint/install/operation observations prevent reaping/shutdown intent. Continuous idle evidence and checkpoint/startup grace are required.

Corrupt/missing/linked/public/changed state cannot reset policy or deployment protection. File-write, file-sync, rename and directory-sync faults yield no usable status until reopen; the accepted generation depends on the durable replacement.

A private D-Bus NetworkManager fixture checks coherent radio/checkpoint snapshots, wrong owner, changing properties, bounded total timeout and zero mutation calls. Missing, malformed, duplicate or unbounded properties are rejected.
The real CLI read both installed root-owned NetworkManager instances from UID 1000 without scanning, changing radio/profile state or rebooting.
limits: No runtime service policy/hold socket API, serialized radio coordinator, radio ownership journal, external-change observer or complete SSH/session observer is integrated yet.
The public library accepts OS observations from its caller; fixture Activity values do not qualify physical session-admission races. Its policy intent is not a radio-write capability.
Setup panel lease renewal/cleanup, deployment script holds, partial-offline scheduling, downloader and install policy remain outstanding.
The source additions are not present in the earlier cd66877 bootstrap runtime/kits, which still contain the completed bootstrap path.
No installed device state, Wi-Fi settings, credentials, boot files, root partitions or watchdog were changed. Tests on Pi 5 used ordinary-user temporary files and a private D-Bus daemon.
The overall OTA goal remains incomplete; root connection details, supervised migration and both-board physical qualification remain pending.
